translations.web: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
translations.bsb: Then he shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering—the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them,
translations.kjv: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
translations.asv: And all the fat of the bullock of the sin-offering he shall take off from it; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
